description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `CsvDataImportServiceTest` for testing the `CsvDataImportService`'s method `getEmployeeArrayFromCSV`. It includes setup of test data and multiple test cases to verify CSV parsing behavior with normal, line-broken, special-character, and invalid content.

classes.name: CsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the behavior of the CSV data import service, specifically testing the parsing of employee data CSV content.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CsvDataImportService instance and header values before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNormalCSVContent
methods.description: Tests parsing of a normal CSV content with header and single data row.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithLineBreaksInCSV
methods.description: Tests parsing of CSV content where fields contain line breaks within quoted strings.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithSpecialCharactersInCSV
methods.description: Tests parsing of CSV content with special characters such as carriage returns, tabs, and null bytes inside quoted fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNonCSVContent
methods.description: Verifies that parsing non-CSV content throws a CSVUploadFailedException with an appropriate message.
